title: Reliance Industries Ltd — Updates
text: This is further to the disclosure dated September 7, 2026 made by the Company. We wish to inform you that the Company executives participated in the Institutional Investors' Meeting - UBS India Summit 2026 and no unpublished price sensitive information was shared/discussed in the said one-on-one meeting.
